text:
maria: Seeing intermittent packet loss and ~20-80ms jitter between gpu-slice pods in us-west-2a -> us-west-2b for batch-serving. Started right after I applied a tiny L4 policy delta to tighten namespace egress.
aj: oof. can you paste the netpol diff?
maria: sure — it was just removing an overly-broad ipBlock allow.
```yaml
- egress:
-  - to:
-      ipBlock:
-        cidr: 10.0.0.0/8
+ egress:
+  - to:
+      namespaceSelector:
+        matchLabels:
+          role: infra
```
leo: that change would've stopped any cross-namespace traffic that relied on the ipBlock fallback. We generally don't use ipBlock for pod->pod east-west, but some infra svcaccounts did.
maria: packet drops observed at 11:12:03 in GPU cluster logs: `rdma: connect timeout` then `heartbeat lost` across several slices.
sre-bot: Incident created: #INC-2026-214  — autoscale suppressed for affected pools.
aj: run `kubectl get networkpolicy -n gpu-slices -o yaml` and `calicoctl get felixlog` please.
maria: Pasting excerpt: `kubectl get np gpu-egress -n gpu-slices -o yaml` shows policy applies to podSelector: slice=worker and egress ports 80,443,5000; no explicit allow for pod CIDR or RDMA ports.
devops: RDMA handshake uses ephemeral high ports + UDP? we have a known quirk: calico default deny + missing egress to podCIDR will block kernel-level heartbeats.
emily: also check MTU — the policy got annotated with a new trafficClass label and the CNI applied a different route (we saw path MTU blackhole symptoms last month).
maria: quick tcpdump from pod shows SYN then RST-like behavior for the heartbeat channel; also saw ICMP fragmentation-needed in node dmesg.
leo: probable explanation: policy removed ipBlock allow that previously let inter-az overlay traffic traverse without explicit podCIDR rule. then CNI attempted path MTU discovery and failed because netpol blocked ICMP for fragmentation.
aj: can we roll back the networkpolicy to previous version?
maria: I reverted to the old policy and applied an explicit rule allowing podCIDR and ICMP for fragmentation:
```yaml
egress:
  - to:
      ipBlock:
        cidr: 10.2.0.0/16
  - to:
      podSelector: {}
    ports:
      - protocol: ICMP
```
maria: after revert, latency/jitter returned to baseline within ~2 min. GPU heartbeats stabilized.
sre-bot: Noted rollback by maria at 11:28.
emily: we should add a presubmit check to catch removal of ipBlock/ICMP in policies that target infra namespaces.
leo: file a small RFC / runbook — this cost us a couple node reschedules and one failed batch job.
aj: adding 2c — the policy editor UI should warn when removing ipBlock for namespaces with podCIDR-dependent services. :warning:
maria: will follow up with postmortem and a grep across repos for similar patterns. thanks all. :thumbsup:
